back.en: Mixture of a metal with other elements — harder, stronger, resists corrosion, better appearance
back.bm: Campuran logam dengan unsur lain — lebih keras, kuat, tahan kakisan, lebih menarik

back.en: Bronze: Cu + Sn. Brass: Cu + Zn
back.bm: Gangsa: Cu + Sn. Loyang: Cu + Zn

back.en: Fe + Cr + Ni + C — doesn't rust; cutlery, surgical tools
back.bm: Fe + Cr + Ni + C — tidak berkarat; sudu garpu, alat pembedahan

back.en: Al + Cu + Mg + Mn — light and strong; aircraft bodies
back.bm: Al + Cu + Mg + Mn — ringan dan kuat; badan kapal terbang

back.en: Sn + Cu + Sb — shiny, resists corrosion; souvenirs (Royal Selangor)
back.bm: Sn + Cu + Sb — berkilat, tahan kakisan; cenderamata (Royal Selangor)

back.en: SiO₂ + Na₂CO₃ + CaCO₃ — cheap, low melting point; windows, bottles
back.bm: SiO₂ + Na₂CO₃ + CaCO₃ — murah, takat lebur rendah; tingkap, botol

back.en: SiO₂ + B₂O₃ — resists thermal shock; lab glassware, oven dishes
back.bm: SiO₂ + B₂O₃ — tahan kejutan haba; radas makmal, bekas ketuhar

front.bm: Kaca silika terlakur & kaca plumbum kristal

back.en: Fused silica: pure SiO₂, very heat-resistant (optical lenses). Lead crystal: high n, sparkles (decorative glass)
back.bm: Silika terlakur: SiO₂ tulen, sangat tahan haba (kanta optik). Plumbum kristal: n tinggi, berkilau (kaca hiasan)

back.en: Heated clay (kaolin) — hard, brittle, heat-resistant, insulator, chemically inert
back.bm: Tanah liat dipanaskan (kaolin) — keras, rapuh, tahan haba, penebat, lengai secara kimia

back.en: Tiles, pottery, spark plugs, brake discs, artificial teeth, superconductors
back.bm: Jubin, tembikar, palam pencucuh, cakera brek, gigi palsu, superkonduktor

back.en: Matrix + reinforcement combined for better properties than either alone
back.bm: Matriks + bahan pengukuh digabungkan untuk sifat lebih baik daripada setiap satu

back.en: Reinforced concrete, fibreglass, optical fibre, photochromic glass, superconductors
back.bm: Konkrit diperkukuh, gentian kaca, gentian optik, kaca fotokromik, superkonduktor

front.en: Why alloys are harder than pure metals
front.bm: Mengapa aloi lebih keras daripada logam tulen

back.en: Foreign atoms of a different size disturb the orderly layers, so the layers cannot slide easily
back.bm: Atom asing yang berbeza saiz mengganggu susunan lapisan yang teratur, jadi lapisan sukar menggelongsor

tip.en: Pure metal: layers slide → soft. Alloy: layers blocked → hard.
tip.bm: Logam tulen: lapisan menggelongsor → lembut. Aloi: lapisan terhalang → keras.

back.en: Fe + C — strong and hard; bridges, buildings, railway tracks
back.bm: Fe + C — kuat dan keras; jambatan, bangunan, landasan kereta api

tip.en: Add Cr and Ni and it becomes stainless steel.
tip.bm: Tambah Cr dan Ni untuk menjadi keluli tahan karat.

back.en: Glass containing silver chloride or silver bromide that darkens in bright light and clears in dim light
back.bm: Kaca yang mengandungi argentum klorida atau argentum bromida yang menjadi gelap dalam cahaya terang dan jernih dalam cahaya malap

example.en: Used in spectacle lenses and car windscreens.
example.bm: Digunakan pada kanta cermin mata dan cermin depan kereta.
